== Summary ==
Identified: [[Hayes Hunter]] (near the columns, looking up) and [[Jacy Smith]] (green pocket t-shirt and beard; same shirt and face as [[:File:2021 World Championship Slack 11 October.jpg]] and the named still [[:File:2021 World Championship trip 1.jpg]]). Other people in the memorial unlabeled.
Inside the Jefferson Memorial in Washington, D.C., on 11 October 2021, the day after the [[2021 World Championship]] (Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]] (trip after the event)
